question: In MS PowerPoint, which of the following keyboard combinations is used to create a new blank presentation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + N**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The keyboard shortcut **Ctrl + N** is used in MS PowerPoint to create a new blank presentation instantly.
 
• Upon pressing **Ctrl + N**, a new presentation opens with the default template applied.
 
• This shortcut is universally recognized across different versions of MS PowerPoint, ensuring ease of use for users.
 
• Using shortcuts like **Ctrl + N** helps in improving workflow efficiency and reduces the dependency on mouse navigation.
 
• Similar shortcuts exist in other Microsoft Office applications like Word and Excel, where **Ctrl + N** is used to create new blank documents or spreadsheets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts in MS PowerPoint:**

 
 
• **Ctrl + O:** Opens an existing presentation.
 
• **Ctrl + S:** Saves the current presentation.
 
• **Ctrl + P:** Opens the print dialog box for the presentation.
 
• **Ctrl + M:** Inserts a new slide in the current presentation.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Shortcuts:**
 
 
• Keyboard shortcuts save time and help users to work more efficiently.
 
• They reduce the dependency on mouse usage, allowing for smoother navigation.
 
 
 
• **MS PowerPoint Overview:**
 
 
• MS PowerPoint is a widely used presentation software developed by Microsoft.
 
• It allows users to create slideshows composed of text, images, videos, and animations.
 
• First launched in 1987, it is a part of the Microsoft Office suite.
 
 
 
• **Other Related Applications:**
 
 
• MS Word: Used for creating text-based documents.
 
• MS Excel: Used for data organization, analysis, and creating spreadsheets.
 
• MS Outlook: Used for managing emails, calendars, and tasks.
